input.summary: Use the outer arcs to keep the ball up top and build bonus to 19K, hit A and B for Double Bonus, then resume top play and collect the saucer when 5,000 is lit.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: Hits on lower rollover buttons, lit upper rollover buttons, and a lit top saucer build the end-of-ball bonus to 19K.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Hit both side A and B standup targets to double the end-of-ball bonus for the current ball.

quickInfo.name: Top saucer
quickInfo.summary: Ten-point switches alternate the saucer between number progress and bonus progress, then between number progress and 5,000 at maximum bonus.

quickInfo.name: Number buttons
quickInfo.summary: The numbered buttons advance in order from 1 through 8, and the next required number is the important direct hit.

quickInfo.name: Per-ball reset
quickInfo.summary: Bonus, Double Bonus, and numbered-target progress reset at the start of each ball.

steps.text: Plunge for the top saucer.
Shoot either outer arc over its lower rollover button to return the ball to the top.
Use repeated top play to build the base bonus to 19K.
After the bonus reaches 19K, hit the A and B side standups from controlled shots.
modeNotes: Double Bonus: Hit both A and B standup targets. The game doubles the end-of-ball bonus for the current ball.

steps.text: Resume the outer-arc route after Double Bonus is ready.
Read the top-saucer lamp. Collect it when 5,000 is lit and the upper feed can reach it.
Do not shoot the center number buttons from the upper flippers unless a specific return has proved safe.

fallback.title: Outer arcs and bonus only
fallback.when: Use this when A-B rebounds, the top saucer, or the center area is dangerous.

steps.text: Ignore the center number buttons.
Repeat the safer outer arc to the top.
Use lit rollovers and incidental saucer entries to build bonus.
Skip Double Bonus if the A-B target returns threaten the ball.

alternatives.title: 5,000 top-saucer route
alternatives.when: Use this after the bonus reaches 19K and the top saucer catches reliably.

steps.text: Score lower rollover buttons, lit upper rollover buttons, or the lit top saucer until base bonus reaches 19K.
Use safe ten-point switches until the top saucer shows 5,000.
Send the ball to the top through the safer outer arc.
Guide upper play into the saucer without a direct center-button shot.
Use outer arcs and rollover buttons to build 19K.
Hit A and B to enable Double Bonus.
Return to top play after the doubled bonus is ready.
Collect the top saucer during its 5,000 state.

techniques.name: Outer-arc top feed
techniques.instruction: Shoot an outer arc over its rollover button. Use the arc that returns the ball to safer upper play.

techniques.name: Saucer-state timing
techniques.instruction: Read the top-saucer lamp before you send the ball upward. At 19K, wait for the 5,000 state.

cautions.issue: Direct shots at the center number buttons can send the ball sideways toward a drain.
cautions.response: Let top play and the small center rollover advance numbers. Avoid direct button shots when the return is not known.

cautions.issue: Shots from the upper flippers to the center buttons create additional side-to-side risk.
cautions.response: Use the upper flippers to continue the top route. Do not force a center-button shot from them.

cautions.issue: Ten-point switches change the lit upper rollovers and the top-saucer state.
cautions.response: Read the lamps again after switch activity. Do not assume that the prior saucer award remains lit.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Toledo or Valencia edition and player count.
Read ball count, award settings, saucer lamp, and arc feeds.

input.simpleOverview: Valencia and Toledo reset bonus, Double Bonus, and numbered-target progress every ball. Use the outer arcs and lit rollovers to reach 19K, hit A and B for Double Bonus, then collect the top saucer when its 5,000 state is lit.
input.overview: Valencia and Toledo build a 19K base bonus through the outer arcs, lit rollovers, and the top saucer. Hit A and B during the same ball for Double Bonus, then resume safe top play and collect the saucer when 5,000 is lit. The 1-through-8 button sequence advances in order and can also be spotted by the saucer.
